items.headline:
The US government is ramping up hiring:

Government job openings jumped +10,000 in June, to 823,000, the highest since June 2025.

This marks the 4th consecutive monthly increase, totaling +98,000.

Since November 2025, available vacancies in the government have surged +165,000.
